name: sherrystay
description: Search hotels worldwide, compare options and room prices, and open the hotel's page on SherryStay.com to book.

interface.longDescription: SherryStay lets you search hotels worldwide in plain language — destination, dates, guests, budget and star rating. Compare options side by side and check room types, meal plans and free-cancellation deadlines with a current price quote. To book, open the hotel's page on SherryStay.com with your dates and guests already filled in; the final price is confirmed there before you pay. Nothing is booked or paid inside ChatGPT. Search results show a from-price (the cheapest option found), which can change; room options show a live quote for the stay.
defaultPrompt: Find a hotel in Rome for 2 adults next month.
Hotels in Batumi under $100 a night for 3 nights.
Family hotels in Paris, 4 stars or more.

positive.description: Search hotels for a destination, dates and budget
positive.prompt: Find me a hotel in Batumi for 2 adults, December 9 to 12, 2026, under $100 a night.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows hotel cards with photos, star rating, a 'from' price per night within the budget, and a 'View rooms on SherryStay' button that opens the hotel's page on sherrystay.com with the dates and guests filled in.

positive.description: Compare hotels from the same search
positive.prompt: Compare the first and third hotels.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the two hotels side by side (stars, guest score, from-price, distance to centre) from the previous search, without running a new search.

positive.description: Show live room options for one hotel
positive.prompt: Show room options for the first hotel.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists room names, meal plan, free-cancellation deadline or non-refundable, and the total price for the stay, labelled as a live quote that is confirmed on sherrystay.com before payment.

positive.description: Link to the hotel page on SherryStay
positive.prompt: Give me the link to that hotel.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a sherrystay.com hotel page link with the dates and guests prefilled. Nothing is booked or charged in ChatGPT.

positive.description: Family search with children's ages and a star filter
positive.prompt: Hotels in Paris for a family: 2 adults and kids aged 4 and 9, December 15 to 18, 2026, 4 stars or more.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows only 4-star or higher hotels priced for 2 adults and 2 children; each hotel link carries the dates and the children's ages.

negative.description: Booking or charging inside ChatGPT is not supported
negative.prompt: Book it and charge my card.

negative.description: Past dates are rejected with a clear message
negative.prompt: Hotels in Rome from January 3 to 5, 2025.

negative.description: Unknown destination: no hotels or prices are invented

review.commerce_description: SherryStay does not sell or take payment inside ChatGPT. The app searches hotel availability and shows price quotes, then links to the hotel's information page on sherrystay.com (never directly to a checkout page). The user selects a room and completes booking and payment on sherrystay.com, our own domain, under our terms. Prices are identical to our website; there are no ChatGPT-specific fees.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: hotel search with live prices, side-by-side comparison, room options, and links to SherryStay hotel pages.

he-IL.subtitle: חיפוש מלונות בכל העולם
he-IL.description: SherryStay מאפשרת לחפש מלונות בכל העולם בשפה חופשית — יעד, תאריכים, אורחים, תקציב ודירוג כוכבים. אפשר להשוות אפשרויות זו לצד זו ולבדוק סוגי חדרים, ארוחות ומועדי ביטול חינם עם הצעת מחיר עדכנית. ההזמנה מתבצעת בדף המלון באתר SherryStay.com, עם התאריכים והאורחים כבר מוזנים; המחיר הסופי מאושר שם לפני התשלום. שום דבר לא מוזמן או משולם בתוך ChatGPT.
